course_name_original: Introduction à la méthode des Eléments Finis
course_name_en: Introduction to the Finite Element Method

learning_outcomes.text: At the end of this course, students will be able to carry out simple linear studies (solid and structural mechanics, thermics), in particular by validating the dimensioning of a structure in a way similar to that used in a design office.
Be able to use this numerical calculation method, which is widely used in engineering departments and research centers.
Be partially familiar with its theoretical foundations.
Get an overview of possible applications.
Be able to communicate with specialists.
Know how to carry out simple linear studies using a commercial reference code: Abaqus.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the finite element method
Comparison with: finite differences, meshless techniques and boundary elements
Variational formulation: principles of virtual power and virtual heat
Linear methods for static and thermal resolution
Getting to grips with a linear calculation code (Natran/Patran)
Steps in building a numerical model
teaching_methods: Use of Scilab and Abaqus software in design office environment
bibliography: The finite element method, O.C. Zienckiewicz, Mac Graw Hill
Une présentation de la méthode des éléments finis, G. Dahtt, G. Touzot, Maloine Editeur
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
